features.description: A user can register, log in, rotate a refresh token, and revoke a session without storing plaintext tokens.
steps: Register a user with valid credentials.
Log in and resolve the access token.
Refresh once and verify the old refresh token is rejected.
Revoke the session and verify access is rejected.

features.description: Authenticated users cannot claim, read, mutate, or delete another user's resources.
steps: Create resources for two users.
Attempt to access the first user's resource with the second identity.
Verify the request is rejected and the resource remains unchanged.

features.description: Conversation messages survive store recreation and remain scoped to their owner and session.
steps: Append user and assistant messages to a session.
Create a new store instance against the same database.
Read the session and verify ordered messages and ownership.

features.description: An interview persists questions, answers, scores, history, archive state, and report inputs.
steps: Create an interview and its first question.
Store a scored answer and successor question.
Reload, archive, restore, and delete the interview.
Verify report aggregation uses persisted scored turns.

features.description: Weak dimensions generate owner-scoped learning tasks with deduplication and expanding review intervals.
steps: Build learning candidates from scored capability data.
Create tasks twice and verify active duplicates are not created.
Review a task and verify its count and next review time advance.

features.description: Private retrieval rejects low-relevance results and returns traceable source metadata for accepted chunks.
steps: Run the dense relevance gate for a query.
Reject results below the configured threshold.
For accepted hybrid results, retain source and score metadata.

features.description: The supervisor exposes the specialist tools and the routing evaluation reports per-agent accuracy.
steps: Build the configured supervisor.
Verify knowledge, interviewer, evaluator, and planner tools are available.
Evaluate recorded routing cases and report per-agent accuracy.

features.description: Only an administrator can list, save, delete, and enqueue ingestion for safe knowledge filenames.
steps: Authenticate as a non-admin and verify the operation is denied.
Authenticate as an administrator and save a supported filename.
List and delete the file while rejecting unsafe paths.

features.description: The primary workspace has no serious accessibility violations or horizontal overflow on supported desktop and mobile viewports.
steps: Build and start the production frontend shell.
Open the Today workspace on desktop and mobile Chromium.
Run accessibility and overflow assertions.

features.description: Conversation history is managed in a searchable dedicated workspace instead of a constrained sidebar list.
steps: Open the product sidebar and verify it contains a History navigation action but no embedded conversation search.
Navigate to /history.
Search, open, rename, archive, restore, and delete owner-scoped conversations.

features.description: Product and administrator accounts use separate creation paths, browser sessions, login endpoints, and user interfaces while server-side roles remain authoritative.
steps: Create a product account through registration and an administrator through the operator script.
Verify each credential is rejected by the other login surface.
Verify the product shell exposes neither backend navigation nor service API-key settings.
Verify admin endpoints continue to require the administrator role.

features.description: A knowledge update becomes visible only after the replacement collection passes validation and can be rolled back.
steps: Build a new versioned collection without changing the serving alias.
Run structural and retrieval regression gates.
Atomically switch the alias and retain the previous version.
Verify a failed build leaves the serving collection unchanged.

features.description: Retrying or concurrently submitting the same interview answer charges and advances the turn at most once.
steps: Submit the same idempotency key concurrently.
Claim the pending turn with a conditional state transition.
Verify exactly one score and one successor turn are persisted.
Return the original result to safe retries.
